cause.title: Session titles repeat the first message instead of naming the work

goal.name: Inbox scan time under 20 seconds
goal.why: A title that repeats the opener makes every row in the inbox look the same, so people open sessions to find out what they are

wrong: Session titles copy the first message, so the inbox fills with rows like "hey can you look at" and people open each one to learn what it is.
change: The title prompt now names the work in a short imperative phrase, ignoring greetings and pasted errors.
